moves.label: Quick Hokuto Jab
moves.description: Fast high pressure-point jab with a tiny active window for close checks.
moves.reason: Compact standing finger jab at upper-body height.

moves.label: Low Sweep Kick
moves.description: Slow low sweep with moderate active time and a punishable recovery.
moves.reason: Low blue-arc kick travels along leg height.

moves.label: Hokuto Body Palm
moves.description: Quick mid palm strike with a short active window and steady recovery.
moves.reason: Short forward body-level palm.

moves.label: Heavy Roundhouse
moves.description: Slow mid roundhouse with moderate active time and committed recovery.
moves.reason: High-commitment arcing kick stays around mid height.

moves.label: Hokuto Arc Smash
moves.description: Slow mid arc smash with a long active swing and quick recovery.
moves.reason: Orange crescent strike swings through mid space.

moves.label: Pressure-Point Launcher
moves.description: Slow mid launcher that taps forward into a long active pop-up.
moves.reason: Forward pressure-point strike is authored as a launcher.

moves.label: Tornado Heel
moves.description: Steady mid jumping tornado kick with a long active window and heavy recovery.
moves.reason: Jumping roundhouse arc is authored as a tornado.

moves.label: Low Shifting Kick
moves.description: Slow low shifting kick with moderate active time and quick recovery.
moves.reason: Side-moving kick sequence stays low.

moves.label: Low Knockdown Rush
moves.description: Slow low knockdown rush with moderate active time and short recovery.
moves.reason: Low forward rush is authored as a knockdown.

moves.label: Homing Hokuto Drop
moves.description: Quick mid jumping knockdown that homes in before the falling strike.
moves.reason: Leap-and-drop kick carries homing tracking and knockdown data.

moves.label: Crouching Crescent Palm
moves.description: Fast mid crouching palm arc with a long active window and quick recovery.
moves.reason: Crouched orange crescent strike covers mid space.

moves.label: Crouch Point Launcher
moves.description: Steady mid launcher with a tiny active pop-up after a crouched start.
moves.reason: Crouch-to-pressure-point hit is authored as a launcher.

moves.label: Overdrive Hokuto Jab
moves.description: Fast high overdrive jab with a long active check and steady recovery.
moves.reason: Overdrive command uses the high pressure-point jab sequence.

moves.label: Hokuto Aura Drive
moves.description: Fast special knockdown drive with very long active pressure and punishable recovery.
moves.reason: Aura drive is authored as a special knockdown.

moves.label: Overdrive Tornado Heel
moves.description: Steady mid jumping tornado kick with a long active window and heavy recovery.
moves.reason: Overdrive kick mirrors the tornado heel animation.

moves.label: Sidestep Low Sweep
moves.description: Fast low sidestep sweep with extended active frames and heavy recovery.
moves.reason: Sidestep kick uses the low blue-arc sweep.

moves.label: Sidestep Jump Kick
moves.description: Steady mid sidestep jump kick with a long active window and heavy recovery.
moves.reason: Sidestep kick leaves the ground into a roundhouse arc.

moves.label: While-Rising Body Palm
moves.description: Steady mid while-rising palm with a short active window and quick recovery.
moves.reason: Rises into a compact body-level palm strike.

moves.label: While-Rising Jump Kick
moves.description: Steady mid jumping kick with a tiny active window and heavy recovery.
moves.reason: While-rising kick leaves the ground before the strike.

moves.label: Ducking Hokuto Jab
moves.description: Fast high ducking jab with a long active check and steady recovery.
moves.reason: Down jab reuses the high pressure-point poke.

moves.label: Low Pressure Kick
moves.description: Fast low kick with extended active frames and heavy recovery.
moves.reason: Down kick is the low sweep family.

moves.label: Diagonal Point Launcher
moves.description: Slow mid launcher with a tiny active pop-up and heavy recovery.
moves.reason: Diagonal pressure-point strike is authored as a launcher.

moves.label: Diagonal Low Kick
moves.description: Fast low diagonal kick with extended active frames and heavy recovery.
moves.reason: Diagonal kick uses the low sweep family.

moves.label: Hokuto Hundred Rush
moves.description: Fast mid rush with long active speed-line pressure and quick recovery.
moves.reason: Forward command shows a rapid Hokuto rush with blue afterimages.

moves.label: Forward Body Palm
moves.description: Steady mid forward palm with a short active window and quick recovery.
moves.reason: Forward command uses the compact mid palm sequence.

moves.label: Advancing Low Kick
moves.description: Fast low advancing kick with extended active frames and heavy recovery.
moves.reason: Forward kick keeps the low blue-arc kick family.

moves.label: Hokuto Rush Jab
moves.description: Fast high rush jab with a long active check and steady recovery.
moves.reason: Quarter-circle jab uses the pressure-point poke sequence.

moves.label: Hokuto Low Rush
moves.description: Fast low rush kick with long active coverage and committed recovery.
moves.reason: Quarter-circle kick advances through the low sweep family.

moves.label: Hokuto Tornado Ender
moves.description: Slow mid jumping tornado ender that knocks down after a brief active hit.
moves.reason: Quarter-circle kick has tornado, jump, and knockdown data.
